name: apme-eap
summary: Deploys the opt-in APME early-access portal demonstration using its owned namespace and playbooks.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses the addon state and reconciles owned APME resources.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before deployment when required AAP, cluster, or reviewed GitHub configuration is unavailable.

readiness: The owned APME deployment reports ready.
AAP integration resources are present only after their prerequisites succeed.

security.secret_storage: Optional GitHub credentials are supplied outside the contract and must not be stored in the shared config file.
security.network_trust: Registry and API access use the configured trusted endpoints.
security.external_actions: No external GitHub change is made automatically.
